# Tomoni AI

> Tomoni is an independent AI consultancy. We help businesses work out where AI genuinely makes them more efficient, and build it in where it does.

Tomoni AI is run by Tom Williams. Based in North Wales, working with businesses across the UK, remotely or on site.

## What we do
- Opportunity assessment: Ten working days immersed in your operation, alongside the people who do the work. We unpack how the business runs day to day: the bottlenecks, the roadblocks, and the jobs that quietly eat the hours. You receive a written case for what to change, in what order, and what each improvement is worth in pounds.
- Improvements, built and proven: Each improvement is built one at a time and tested on your own live cases before anything goes into service, so nobody is asked to trust a demonstration. Your team are shown exactly how it works. We connect to the software you already run wherever we can.
- Ongoing operation and support: An improvement is only valuable if it is still working next year, when nobody is thinking about it. We host, monitor, maintain and improve it as your business changes, and report every month on what it delivered, in hours and in pounds.
